note: Rigid airship dressed with the Taotie Kit; a showpiece, not a museum object. Size chosen: hull 420 mm long (nose +X), 64 mm across before relief and flanges, axis 150 mm above the plinth. Parts: body (hull, both halves × registers + nose cap), fins (4 plates), flanges (keels + sides), gondola (control car), engines (4 cars with struts and propellers), mooring (nose cone + tail knob), stand (foot, mast, dragon, cradle).
